source.operator_quote: FS-Q1 - this is easy to calculate the required number 3 times the number of units. what is the issue? even though it didnt include the number

decisions.question: MB-59 / FS-Q1: a requirement the notice prints no figure for, that the rule calculates, is calculated and scored as answered
decisions.recommendation: Amend FS-Q1 (CHAT-197): where the notice prints no required figure but the keyed rule calculates it (e.g. maximum bedrooms = 3 x dwelling units, 10.20.40.1(8)(B); A0055/26SC#1), the model calculates the requirement and the row is scored ANSWERED (CHAT-198.NN-Q1 class) with its verdict against the applicant's figure; it is neither NOT MODELLED nor NO ANSWER. Rule text: Where the notice prints no required figure but the keyed rule calculates it (e.g. maximum bedrooms = 3 x units), the model calculates it and the row is scored as answered.
